content:
The analysis failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in margin calculations and formatting errors in the summary output.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, test_rows_and_order failed with close(369.2, 6276.4) returning False, and test_totals_and_decision showed a large mismatch: close(26185.96, 1090.76). Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because the formatted value '26,185.96' (with commas) was missing from the summary text, which contained '$26185.96' instead.
